title: Notre-Dame school
description: School of High Middle Age composers associated with Notre-Dame cathedral, Paris
extract: The Notre-Dame school or the Notre-Dame school of polyphony refers to the group of composers working at or near the Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris from about 1160 to 1250, along with the music they produced.
